forwardErrata.subject: Host-S1 capacity namespace was repository-scoped
forwardErrata.previous: <repository>/.palimpsest/host-capacity/ — the slot was keyed by the protected repository
forwardErrata.corrected: %LOCALAPPDATA%/Palimpsest/host-capacity/ — the slot is keyed by the Windows principal on this machine
forwardErrata.evidence: baseline-security-falsifiers.json F3: a confined process granted only repository A's workspace read repository B's ACTIVE-world canary
forwardErrata.note: The repository-scoped design was never measured before Host-S1 shipped it. The measurement is what falsified it.

forwardErrata.subject: Host-S1 automatic stale-lock reclamation was unsafe
forwardErrata.previous: an abandoned lock was reclaimed by rename-then-verify, and the Host-S1 evidence reported that as qualified
forwardErrata.corrected: automatic reclamation is DISABLED; an ambiguous lock refuses with a named operator action
forwardErrata.evidence: baseline-security-falsifiers.json F1: the recovery moved a live successor, a third party acquired the vacated pathname, and the recovery did not terminate
forwardErrata.note: §6.4 permits the fallback. Exclusive ownership is the security requirement; automatic recovery is an availability feature.
